item.title: Two dozen House Republicans go to war with Senate GOP over SAVE America Act
item.summary: A group of House Republicans is putting Senate leadership on notice, vowing to "filibuster" all Senate measures until the Trump-backed SAVE America Act reaches the president's desk.

item.title: Trump resurfaces old tweet from intel official who resigned
item.summary: President Trump pointed to a 2020 tweet by Joe Kent after he resigned from the position of National Counterterrorism Center director due to his opposition to the Iran war.

item.title: Senate to question Trump intel leaders on Iran war after top official quits in protest
item.summary: President Donald Trump's spy chiefs are set to testify publicly on the Iran war amid growing controversy over the conflict's justification.

item.title: Winning the battles, losing the war? America must define the endgame in Iran
item.summary: Pete Hegseth acknowledges Iran campaign success but some question whether airstrikes achieve regime change goals as Mojtaba Khamenei vows to fight.

item.title: US bunker-buster bombs hammer Iranian anti-ship missile sites near Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The U.S. military dropped 5,000-pound bunker buster bombs on Iranian anti-ship missile sites near Strait of Hormuz, targeting threats to international shipping.

item.title: Bongino fires back at Joe Kent's claim Iran posed 'no imminent threat' to US
item.summary: Former FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino challenges ex-counterterrorism official's claim that Iran poses no imminent threat, citing classified intelligence.

item.title: Fiery aftermath of Iran missile strike near Tel Aviv caught on video after 2 killed
item.summary: Video footage captured fiery destruction and emergency crews responding after an Iranian missile strike near Tel Aviv, Israel, killed two people.

item.title: DNI Tulsi Gabbard says Trump acted because he concluded the Iranian regime 'posed an imminent threat'
item.summary: Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard stated in a post on X that President Donald Trump moved against Iran based on his conclusion that the regime "posed an imminent threat."

item.title: Jon Stewart blasts California Dems, warning their eight candidates may split vote, lead to GOP victory
item.summary: Jon Stewart criticized California Democrats for running eight candidates to replace Gavin Newsom, warning the split vote could help Republicans win.

item.title: Genealogy boom exposes personal data scammers can exploit
item.summary: Using genealogy websites can expose personal data that scammers use to target families, according to experts warning about privacy risks.
